title: Two Rust tests that build a fresh git repository failed with "fatal: not a git repository" in a full gate under heavy concurrent load
outcome: The cause of the transient "not a git repository" failure is identified and removed or contained, so test fixtures that build a fresh repository fail only for a real defect
acceptance: Two Rust tests that build a fresh git repository failed with "fatal: not a git repository" in a full gate under heavy concurrent load is done
